scene: You step off the gondola onto the breezy, neon-lit cinema roof.
picture: Side-view pixel art of a rooftop cinema. Far left, the open metal gondola rests on a cable. Left, a hovering yellow popcorn drone hums. Centre, a teenage Pacific Islander girl in a sky-blue windbreaker stands beside a brass cloud projector. Right sits an empty striped red deckchair. Far right, neon roof railings.
shown: a hovering yellow drone holding warm bags of popcorn on the left
a brass beam projector mounted on a pedestal at the centre
an empty striped red deckchair set up on the right
